items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The 4-line change matches the existing style. It adds a short comment explaining why auth is re-joined ('parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth'), and the names are clear.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: This is a minimal change in the right function that reuses parse_url's auth field. No new helpers, duplicated logic or debug leftovers. It is identical to the reference fix.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard means URLs without credentials are untouched. Auth is passed through exactly as given, with no encoding changes. There is no exception handling to get wrong and no magic constants.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged and only `netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])` is added. There is no special-casing for urllib3 or the Python version. The existing tests for URLs without auth pass (P2P 185/185).
